title: storage-iac-e2e-backup-encryption-and-upgrade-path
creator: Miguel Torres
description: Create a unified Terraform module and upgrade path to enforce encrypted-by-default storage primitives for Private (VPC) deployments. Module must provision EBS volumes, EFS filesystems, and S3 buckets with standardized snapshot/backup lifecycle policies, KMS key usage (customer-managed where required), bucket keys, and sane defaults for retention and tagging. Deliverables include module code, upgrade guide, automated health checks, and an e2e restore test runbook.
acceptance_criteria: EBS volumes created by the module are encrypted with the configured KMS key (default CMK or customer-supplied) and have lifecycle snapshot policy attached
EFS file systems have encryption at rest enabled, lifecycle policy for infrequent access, and daily backup schedule managed via DataLifecycleManager/Backup
S3 buckets enforce default encryption with bucket key enabled, block public access true, lifecycle rules for snapshots/retention, and logging to internal audit bucket
Module supports zero-downtime upgrades from v2 to v3 provider patterns with migration helpers and documented Terraform state change steps
Health checks emit CloudWatch metrics and Terraform-managed SSM documents that run weekly restore verification; alerts surface in Console/PagerDuty when fails
All changes include CI plan/apply steps, acceptance tests in CI, and a documented rollback plan
tasks: Design module interfaces: variables for kms_key_id, retention_days, owner_tag, backup_window
Implement resources: aws_ebs_volume (with snapshot lifecycle via aws_backup_plan), aws_efs_file_system, aws_s3_bucket with server_side_encryption_configuration
Add account-scoped default KMS key option + optional customer-supplied CMK with iam roles and grant propagation
Write upgrade/migration helper TF code to convert existing unencrypted buckets/volumes to encrypted variants using in-place copy or snapshot-and-restore
Create CloudWatch metrics + Lambda-based validator that verifies snapshot integrity and accessible restores
Author e2e restore runbook and schedule weekly runs via SSM Automation
Add unit/acceptance tests to terraform-ci (plan output assertions + live apply in sandbox)
decision: We will require encryption-by-default with an opinionated set of defaults (30d snapshot retention for dev, 90d for prod) but allow overrides via variables. Use Terraform AWS provider v4-compatible resource names and keep provider-agnostic abstractions minimal. For upgrades, prefer snapshot-and-attach when in-place encryption is unsupported and provide helper scripts in scripts/migrate-encryption.sh. We will use customer-managed CMKs for Enterprise accounts and a managed default CMK for internal sandbox usage.
upgrade_notes: Provider changes: target aws provider >= 4.54.0; audit references to deprecated resource arguments and update to block_public_acls/block_public_policy

S3 encryption: enable bucket_key = true and apply server_side_encryption_configuration; for existing unencrypted buckets run migration path: create new encrypted bucket -> sync objects with aws s3 sync -> swap aliases and delete old bucket
EBS: create snapshot of unencrypted volume, copy snapshot encrypted using CMK, create new encrypted volume from copied snapshot and attach during low-traffic window
EFS: use create_file_system with encrypted = true; for migrating existing data run lifecycle cutover using rsync between mount targets and update mount targets post-migration
State changes: add detailed plan reviewers and run tfstate snapshots before apply; record step-by-step state modifications in upgrade guide
health_checks: CloudWatch metric: BackupSuccessCount per resource type - alarm if < 1 per day
Lambda validator: attempt a restore from latest snapshot to a small test instance and run checksum validation
Terraform null_resource with local-exec in sandbox runs weekly to verify S3 object access and encryption headers
SSM Automation document terraform-storage-verify that orchestrates the above checks and posts results to the Console dashboard
testing_plan: Create a sandbox environment in eu-west-1 and us-west-2 and run full module apply/destroy cycles in CI
Add acceptance test that provisions an encrypted EBS volume, writes a marker file to a test EC2, snapshots, restores from snapshot to new volume, and validates marker file
S3 test: upload sample objects, enable default encryption, run migration path for existing unencrypted objects and validate object metadata key headers
Run weekly e2e restore using SSM Automation and post results to #infra-backups Slack channel
